about: irpina's released fxkit 0.1 (elekloader tag fxkit-v0.1) for Digitone OS 1.43 and 1.44, pinned unchanged: the build the effect pedals were tested with. Source in sdk/digitone/dependencies/fxkit.

mods.title: fxkit
mods.summary: What the Digitone's effect mods share (DigiSwarm, DigiPrism, DigiTide, DigiTriad, DigiReel, DigiHoard, DigiHalo from 0.2): one effect at a time owns the audio, with a mixer around it (input levels as loud as the Digitone's own input), two LFOs on the stock LFO page, p-locks kept in the pattern and the MIDI hand-off. On its own it adds nothing: an effect that needs it ticks it here. Needs core-dn1 4.1, which the shop takes for it.
mods.description: What the Digitone mk1's effect mods share: one effect at a time has the audio (exclusive, the synths muted), with a mixer around it (the inputs' levels and pans, mix, balance, volume, width), two LFOs with the stock LFO's rates and waves aimed only at its knobs, and p-locks kept in the pattern, in one track's lock table (T4 unless the effect's SETUP says otherwise), that play on their steps and save with the pattern. Each effect stays a mod of its own, with its own Mod Menu entry and page; fxkit draws its MIXER and LFO pages and keeps its LOCK mode. On its own it adds nothing to the screen. Needs core-dn1 4.1.
mods.author: irpina
mods.on_unit: Tested on a Digitone mk1 by its author with the 0.2 effects (Oct 2026); still a beta. Also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. Not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
